tei:div.tei:p: 345)gsang mdzod las: gtor 'bul dngos grub bum bzang bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: yid 'ong rin chen snod nang du: dkar gsum la sogs zas sna bshams: swa bha wa yis stong par sbyangs: a kā ro yis byin gyis brlabs: nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum mthar: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rin chen gtor snod yangs pa'i nang: 'dod yon longs spyod bsam mi khyab: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin chen po: zag med bde chen bskyed pa'i rdzas: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang: ji lta mkhyen cing ji snyed gzigs: mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal la: bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyi: tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa dang: sgrib gnyis dri ma kun bral nas: mkhyen gnyis shes rab 'bar ba dang: shin tu gsal ba'i blo gros kyis: 'chad rtsod rtsom la dbang 'byor zhing: 'gro don rgya chen 'byung bar shog: khyed thugs mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis: bdag blo'i rmongs pa kun sangs te: thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin zhing: ye shes snang ba 346)mngon gyur nas: gzhon nu bum sku'i dgongs klong du: tshe 'dir gtan srid zin par shog: oṃ gu ru mañdzu shrī mūm̐ hrīḥpradzñā war+dha na ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ lan bdun nam ni nyer gcig gis: phul mthar gtor mgron lha nyid ni: 'od zhu rang la thim bsam zhing: pra ti gh+ri ha ṇa i maṃ: zhes brjod dmigs med rig ngo skyong: de yis don gyi lha zhal mthong: rig stong chos sku'i sa thob nges: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa'ang rin po che'i bzhed pa skong phyir gsang phug o rgyan rdzong nas su kha badz+ra gyis nyams ris su bris pa'o// maṅga lam//
